# ToggleButtonGroup { #anylumino.astryx.ToggleButtonGroup }

```python
ToggleButtonGroup(
    items,
    value=None,
    *,
    label,
    selection_mode='single',
    orientation='horizontal',
    size=None,
    disabled=False,
    **props,
)
```

Render a single- or multiple-selection group of toggle buttons.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                           | Description                                                                                                                | Default        |
|----------------|--------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| items          | Iterable\[Any\]                | Button labels, ``(label, value)`` pairs, or item mappings. Mappings can also set ``disabled`` and individual button props. | _required_     |
| value          | str \| Iterable\[str\] \| None | Selected value for single selection, or selected values for multiple selection.                                            | `None`         |
| label          | str                            | Accessible label for the group.                                                                                            | _required_     |
| selection_mode | str                            | ``"single"`` for exclusive selection or ``"multiple"`` for independent selections.                                         | `'single'`     |
| orientation    | str                            | Horizontal or vertical button layout.                                                                                      | `'horizontal'` |
| size           | str \| None                    | Default size inherited by every toggle button.                                                                             | `None`         |
| disabled       | bool                           | Whether all toggle buttons are disabled.                                                                                   | `False`        |
| **props        | Any                            | Additional JSON-safe ToggleButtonGroup props forwarded to Astryx.                                                          | `{}`           |

## Astryx Props {.doc-section .doc-section-astryx-props}

``children``, ``value``, ``label``, ``type``, ``orientation``, ``size``, and
``isDisabled`` are adapted by the named arguments above. ``**props`` keeps
the wrapper forward-compatible with additional JSON-safe Astryx props.

See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/ToggleButtonGroup>.
